name: juggle-knives-deals-one-damage-to-champion-and-class-bonus-draws
notes: Juggle Knives: 1 damage to target champion, Class Bonus draw. Pre-fix the damage source was an undefined variable.

rulesClauses: Deal 1 damage to target champion. [Class Bonus] Draw a card.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Juggle Knives: the generated handler ($obj, the damage source) read a variable that was only defined in the ability body that queued it (PHP closures do not share scope), so it was undefined (null) at resolution. Overridden in Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php; the value is recomputed where it is used.
